name: Trouble Borrowing
overview: Scripture encourages believers not to be anxious about their needs, including the challenges of borrowing or financial trouble. Jesus teaches in Matthew 6:25-30 that God provides for His creation, reminding us that if He cares for the birds and clothes the lilies, He will surely care for His children. Trusting in God's provision frees us from worry, as human effort cannot add a single cubit to our stature or secure our future apart from His care.
